newsitem.title: USA: Syratech stake raised by Gabelli group.
newsitem.headline: Syratech stake raised by Gabelli group.

text.p: A group led New York investment manager Mario Gabelli said Thursday it raised its stake in Syratech Corp to 1,014,800 common shares or 11.70 percent.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include a net 101,100 common shares bought between February 4 and February 18 at prices ranging from $31.50 to $31.9250 per share.
Syratech, of East Boston, Mass., designs, manufactures, imports and markets a diverse portfolio of table top giftware and seasonal products.
